items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 October 2026 11:16am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 15 October 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in the east at first.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure over Iceland, cold front slowly moving southeast.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, but southwest 5 or 6 in the east of the area at first, becoming west 3 or 4 in all waters this afternoon. Then increasing west or northwest 4 or 5 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight this evening.


##Weather##

Rain soon clearing to the southeast, then becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, soon veering north or northwest, then northeast 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in places.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
